title: End-to-end nonprofit kit build and independent second-worker check
setup: Recorded local test of a weekly volunteer shift-schedule kit, using example data and muse-spark-1.3-contributor with two separate worker keys; actual workerd with SQLite Durable Objects and D1
execution_scope: Local queue runtime with real model calls. Build and review completed; the parent request remained ready, held for a person. No delivery or publication was performed.
notes: Worker 1 drafted the kit, its 8 unit tests and its README in 207.27 seconds (25 model calls).
Worker 2, holding a different key, ran all 8 unit tests and checked the stated coverage rules in 82.73 seconds (14 model calls), recording 0 violations on the example input.
Public test work used muse-spark-1.3-contributor; live requests use the standard tier.
